messages:
alice: planning to integrate a Thales nShield HSM for private deployments (racks + VPC-edge). need guidance: minimal RBAC for keystore-proxy SA, essential audit events for non-repudiation, natless edge egress patterns, and a short sim to validate compromise handling. cc @dexter @priya @sec-oncall

dexter: short plan: least-priv SA, envelope keys (KEK in HSM), egress proxy pattern for fixed source IPs, and SIEM ingestion of both k8s audit + HSM logs.

priya: RBAC example (minimal):
```yaml
kind: Role
metadata: {name: ks-proxy-read, namespace: priv-edge}
rules: [{apiGroups:[""],resources:["secrets"],verbs:["get","list"]}]
```
Bind only to serviceAccount keystore-proxy in same ns. use projected tokens bound to audience and 2m TTL.

alice: audit retention? needs to cover incident window + compliance (90d)?

sec-oncall: capture RequestResponse for secrets/keystore endpoints, Authentication, Authorization, and HSM call metadata (src pod, sa, dest IP, nonce). Ship to SIEM with signed transport. Retain hot-index for 30d, cold storage 3 years (policy dependent).

dexter: network: prefer egress-proxy svc with fixed NAT IPs; NetPols restrict pod->proxy only. fallback is node egress allowlist but it's brittle.

priya: quick sim for SA compromise: create ephemeral SA with same Role, exfil token from a pod, attempt keystore decrypt from different ns, expect SIEM alert on unusual ns + decrypt spike, then revoke SA + rotate wrapped KEK.

sec-oncall: alerts to add ASAP: unusual namespace calling /keystore, decrypt-rate spike per-SA, HSM auth failures, missing audit stream.

ops-bot: note: scheduled maintenance window 2026-04-02T01:00Z will run network egress tests if PR merged.

alice: thanks all 914 I'll open a PR with Role/NetPol snippets and HSM IPs. Anything else?
